rationale:
Retain program_20 for the requested prospective paired generation comparison with updates={}. It already uses predicted_endpoint_world_A, endpoint_pointcloud and flowr_endpoint_vjp. Across the 22 supplied adaptive discovery rows its mean predicted pIC50 delta is greatest (+0.23029894), validity change is +0.01, and MMFF relief per heavy median/p90 are 0.476946/0.954550. This is a candidate choice, not a demonstrated independent winner. R7 (program_3) is nearly tied (+0.22929257; p90 1.252575); program_4 has best-valid 8.558043 but validity change -0.02, while regional program_19 has mean +0.21283937 and lower p90 0.907866. The small observed lead does not support another scalar retune.

The complete supplied support consists of 50 observed nodes t=0.00 through 0.49 within the data-bound [0.0,0.5] window; native continuation must finish to 1. Endpoint levels support geometry hypotheses: pair_kernel_2.5 +0.630662 z, CI [0.495155,0.757860], q=0.00002189, 14/14 positive; shape_yy -0.512823 z, q=0.00001494, 14/14 negative. Regional analysis jointly corrects 600 tests, yielding 69 level, 22 enrichment-change and 21 parent-edge supports. Neither rates nor increments are physical velocity. Regions overlap, negative covariances do not imply universal compression, and these joint-label associations do not locate causal binding motifs. The head reads pooled latent features in the same forward as the endpoint forecast; its label is not an independent endpoint-coordinate affinity evaluation. No supplied current-state comparison establishes that current-state features are weaker.

Do not replace the retained intact point clouds by fitted directions: all 24 audited fits fail runtime fidelity. The strongest positive reproducible soft-mass localization is landmark_00 (+0.639235 z, CI [0.492460,0.790651], q=0.00018795, 14/14 positive), yet first/last observed node effects are -0.365951/-0.275338 z. It cannot become constant signed attraction. Compressed nearest-teacher matching has excess fixed RMS +0.080974 A, batch CI95 [0.069695,0.092142], and overlap 0.469741, but compressed/full teacher-score correlations are 0.101826/0.064078. Nonnegative excess is constructed and neither correlation establishes affinity benefit; preserving point-cloud detail is a representation choice rather than a causal explanation.

Diagnostic decisions are conditional on delivered control. For flat signed final response, inspect finite differences, zero/native parity, injection RMS, individual absolute paired changes, caps/backtracking and terminal persistence before dose exploration; those measurements are absent here. For negative response, revise target/representation rather than infer insufficient strength: R9 (program_0) has mean -0.04142869 and window-shape improvement fraction 0.014364; R6 (program_9) has -0.00633867 and -0.005112. Positive response supports retaining the promising parent; no Steer100 comparison is supplied, so a gain below or above Steer cannot be asserted. A stronger dose is not automatically better: R10 (program_18), native_rms_ratio=0.51, gives +0.20678879 versus R7 ratio=0.30 and +0.22929257; program_8 ratio=0.867 gives +0.13900149. These rows lack paired uncertainty and do not measure window-to-final loss.

Retain the recorded endpoint teacher reference rather than substitute sparse terminal-credit strata. Of 700 batch-nodes, 349 have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 fewer than 6; terminal teachers vary from 17 to 28 with at most 2 per batch. No one of 400 survival tests passes BH (minimum q=0.120427). Node-ancestor medians are not supplied. Last recorded joint head time is 0.99, whereas state time is 1.0; terminal descendant credit is not final decoded affinity rescore. Extinction credit stays missing/null, never zero; full-window sparse-credit high/low fitting is unsupported, and descendants cannot increase independent batch count or confer clone-count teacher mass.

Execute only the retained registered loss: q_m=mean_i ||Y_i-T_m,assignment(i)||^2; rho_delta(q)=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1); R=tau*logsumexp(log(pi_m)-rho_delta(q_m)/tau), with detached Hungarian correspondence and nearest-K prior pi=softmax(-C/T+beta*(s-mean(s))). Preserve native_rms_ratio=0.33, K=4, T=4 A^2, beta=2, tau=0.5, robust_delta=2 and ramp power=0. Recorded block weights [0,1,2,1] monitor this point-cloud formula; they do not reweight its direct coordinate objective. Pull back the conditional geometry loss through the actual FLOWR endpoint Jacobian at old x_t with detached self-conditioning, anchor, assignment and prior; detach/exclude affinity outputs. Return detached predictions/self-conditioning for native integration, then add bounded relative-RMS injection using recorded caps/backtracking. This lagged injection has only a first-order predicted reward response without a new forward, not measured endpoint reward improvement. Preserve positive scheduled support at every observed controlled node unless its gradient vanishes, free native atom/bond transitions, and zero additional production target/head forwards. A reference/derivative change would require actual FLOWR finite differences with separately logged extra-forward count and full 100-step zero/native equivalence; neither is certified by this response.

Freeze this candidate before fresh paired comparison. Assess matched-native mean predicted affinity first with all failure denominators and score coverage; report valid/unique means, best valid/PB-fast and unique Top5 separately, then secondary strain means/tails among comparable-affinity programs. Supplied quality rows omit these complete denominators, comparisons and a material-strain margin. No inference or source edit was performed. failure_modes: Adaptive reused discovery rows have no independent validation or paired comparison interval; the program_20/program_3 mean difference is not established superiority.
All-attempt counts, explicit failure denominators, score coverage, valid/unique means, PB-fast, unique Top5 and matched strain means are absent; a material strain regression margin is unspecified.
A small signed mean does not establish a weak delivered dose. Actual FLOWR finite differences, full zero/native equivalence, injection RMS, absolute changes and persistence are not supplied or run.

No fitted time direction passes the supplied audit. Whole-window signed enrichment can contradict first/last-node signs, and region overlap or negative covariance cannot establish a universal force or compression rule.
The joint latent-head label is not independent coordinate-only affinity; information-audit excess RMS and teacher correlations cannot certify a causal affinity mechanism or reward advantage.

Sparse descendant coverage prevents full-window terminal-credit stratification. Preserve extinction as null and distinguish t=0.99 recorded head scores from decoded final affinity; node ancestor medians are unavailable.

Reward derivatives are conditional on detached teacher correspondence/prior/anchor/self-conditioning. Identity, saved-endpoint-only or surrogate gradients and affinity-head backpropagation would violate the registered derivative contract.
Lagged old-state VJP prediction is not a measured reward improvement at the post-native state. Re-forwarding a production reward/head to claim measurement is not authorized.

No GPU execution, directional-derivative audit, formula-test result or native-equivalence pass is claimed. Retention preserves the bound program without certifying its implementation or final benefit.

A fresh comparison that regresses final affinity or materially worsens comparable-affinity strain must not overwrite the historical promising parent; heldout results cannot retune the frozen candidate.
